versions.changelog: Rewrite concurrent write protection section: broaden from Feishu-only to universal pattern (Excel/local files/APIs all share the same root cause). Add problem panorama table, unified protection rules, and three iron laws: single writer, incremental over full, parallel read serial write.
Add Phase 0: pre-recording discipline - write task requirements and plan to daily notes before execution to survive crashes without losing context. Also includes post-task cleanup of working memory.
Initial release: divide-and-conquer strategies, timeout control, checkpoint recovery, concurrent write protection
